items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: I think Pettis told me that they played as two separate, that the two four-piece bands got together as an eight-piece band, often on Sundays.

ctx.x: Frank Snyder tells me about their meeting, Brunus, over here on North Avenue in Halsted, where they'd come to Jim, finding some people that they could work with. And he said that's where he met Brunus long before they joined together to form the New Orleans Rhythm Kings.
I think Pettis told me that they played as two separate, that the two four-piece bands got together as an eight-piece band, often on Sundays.
